scope: Offline public-distribution review; no hardware, service or RF changes

history_review.gitleaks_scope: All reachable Git history including merge-parent diffs (--all --full-history -m), plus a clean tracked-file checkout
history_review.review_limit: Automated scans do not prove absence of every secret or embedded identifier. Historical lab paths, private network addresses and the lab card MAC remain in old reports and history. Decoded Wi-Fi reports omit SSIDs and packet addresses.

local_tests.skip_reason: Optional separately built pinned GNU Radio LoRa modem absent

clean_checkout_without_private_inputs.note: Unittest reports include class-level skips for absent firmware/ROM inputs; counts differ from the local checkout. No skipped check is claimed as passed.

hosted_ci: Verified separately on the publication pull request; local checks are not a substitute for its result
